name: Fabtech Technologies Ltd
title: Fabtech Technologies Ltd - 544558 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Turnkey pharma/healthcare facility builder; margins compressing (contribution ~43.8% vs 45.9%) with receivables up to ₹204 cr and no capacity discipline data, so the cash-conversion story is unproven despite ~25% growth guidance.

triggers.label: Receivables up to ₹204.34 cr
triggers.quote: The receivables have risen to ₹ 204.34 crore.

triggers.label: RMC cost up ~33%, execution cost up ~43%
triggers.quote: the RMC cost, which grew up by close to 33%, and the last was the execution cost, which was up to 43%

triggers.label: Order conversion 11% → 16–17% of hot leads
triggers.quote: our conversion is now getting improved. It is now 11% and it is reaching and hitting to around 16 to 17 percent of the hot lead.

guidance.quote: we are projecting approximately 25% growth ahead
an improvement in PAT margin towards 9.9% to 10.5% range
at EBITDA level, our target is to do around 13 to 14%
PAT level will be between 9 to 11% is what our internal targets are
